title: Hauyne
description: A 1.21.1 fabric modpack made for the sodalite smp!
body:
A modpack I Tried to keep vanilla+
50 mods (75 MB), 33 required mods and 17 optional mods
Most optional mods are for preformance, although EMI (which the server runs. Sorry JEI fans), Customizable Player Models, Figura, and Iris are also included

This modpack featers
- Farmer's Delight
- 6 mods from the Let's Do series
- Sophisticated Backpacks
- Framed Blocks
- Carry On
- and more! (check out the changelog if you wish to know all of them)

feel free to add any mods of your choosing to your instance
